{{recipe}} 

== Ingredients ==
*24 large (15/20) [[Cookbook:Shrimp|shrimp]], peeled, deveined, and butterflied
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] dark [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]
*1 ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
*2 tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]], halved
*Sweetened shredded [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]], or shredded fresh coconut
*[[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]] for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep-frying]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine rum and seasonings. Pour over shrimp and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, 8 hours for most (the alcohol will cook it after that).
#[[Cookbook:Dredging|Dredge]] shrimp in coconut. Let rest at room temperature 2–3 minutes.
#Heat oil to 350°F. Fry shrimp 6 at a time 3 minutes.
#Drain on a cooling rack above a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|sheet pan]].
#Squeeze some lemon juice over and serve warm.
